name: EMEET NOVA 4K Webcam
details: 🌟 Unrivaled 4K Performance – 4K UHD at 30fps with CMOS sensor for stunning clarity (defaults to 1080p, switchable to 4K via software).
🎯 Precise Autofocus – PDAF tech ensures sharp images within 7.9–118 inches, plus auto light adjustment and fixed 73° FOV.
🎤 Dual Noise-Cancelling Mics – Clear, natural audio pickup up to 8 feet away with advanced noise suppression.
🔌 Plug & Play USB 2.0 – Instant setup with no drivers; works with Windows 10/11, macOS 10.14+, Android TV 7.0+, Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, etc.
🔒 Privacy Protection – Magnetic privacy cover prevents unwanted surveillance, no WiFi/Bluetooth for enhanced security.
🌀 Flexible Design – 360° horizontal rotation, 15° vertical tilt, 180° adjustable stand, plus tripod mount support.
🛡️ Stable Build – Rubber grip and strong swivel connection for firm, secure mounting; comes with 1.5m fixed cable.

name: HP 620 FHD Webcam
details: 📸 Made for Video Conferencing – 4 MP camera with Full HD 1080p resolution and dual noise-reducing microphones for crystal-clear video calls.
🤖 Video Enhancing AI Features – AI-powered autofocus, zoom, and auto backlight correction ensure impeccable video quality in any lighting.
🔄 Full Adjustability – 360° swivel, 90° tilt-down, and adjustable field of view (66°, 78°, 92°) for capturing every angle with precision.
💻 Seamless Compatibility – Zoom Certified USB 3.0 Type-A webcam with Windows Hello support and integration with leading conferencing apps.
🌱 Sustainable Design – Built from 70% post-consumer recycled plastic and packaged in eco-friendly recyclable materials.
🛡️ 1-Year Warranty – Backed by HP’s standard one-year limited warranty for reliability and peace of mind.

name: Dell WB3023 2K QHD Webcam
details: 📺 Uncompromised Video Quality – 2K QHD resolution with a Sony image sensor for crystal-clear, vivid, and vibrant picture clarity.
🎤 Thoughtful Design – Built-in noise reduction microphone ensures clear communication, while a sliding privacy shutter protects your privacy when not in use.
🖇️ Flexible Mounting – Integrated mounting clip for easy attachment to monitor, notebook, or tripod.
🤝 Seamless Collaboration – Microsoft Teams and Zoom certified for smooth integration, with customizable settings via Dell Peripheral Manager software.
🎥 Adjustable View – Tilt and swivel functionality lets you find the perfect angle for video calls or recordings.

name: Logitech C920 HD Pro Webcam
details: 🎥 Full HD Clarity – Stream or video call in crisp 1080p/30fps or 720p/30fps with a fixed 78° diagonal field of view that perfectly frames you and your space.
🎤 Dual Microphones – Two built-in mics capture natural, clear, and realistic sound from multiple angles for professional-quality audio in every call.
🎬 Creative Control – Logitech Capture app gives you powerful tools to create, record, and customize settings, making video production simple and professional.
💡 Optimized Lighting – Logitech RightLight 2 technology automatically adjusts to dim or uneven lighting, ensuring bright and well-contrasted video in any environment.
🔍 Premium Optics – Full HD five-element glass lens with fast, accurate autofocus delivers razor-sharp, consistently high-quality video for Zoom, Skype, and beyond.

name: eMeet S600 4K Webcam
details: 🌟 Unmatched 4K Quality – Equipped with a Sony 1/2.5'' sensor, enjoy crisp 4K at 30FPS or ultra-smooth 1080P at 60FPS, perfect for streaming, gaming, or content creation.
⚡ Advanced PDAF Autofocus – Phase Detection Autofocus ensures faster, sharper, and more stable focusing with automatic light balance for vivid detail even in low-light conditions.
🎤 Premium Audio – Dual noise-canceling microphones capture crystal-clear voice with proprietary filtering technology. Customize mic settings through EMEETLINK software.
📐 Adjustable FOV – Switch between 40° and 73° field of view to either spotlight yourself or include more of your environment for dynamic, flexible streaming.
🔒 Privacy & Durability – Built-in privacy cover and rugged engineering ensure long-lasting stability with flexible rotation and tilt adjustment to find your perfect angle.
🔌 Plug & Play Convenience – USB 2.0/3.0 support for instant setup across major operating systems. For advanced users, EMEETLINK software allows image and audio fine-tuning.

name: Logitech Brio 300 Full HD Webcam
details: 🎥 Full HD 1080p at 30fps – Experience crystal-clear and professional video quality, perfect for online meetings, video calls, and content creation. The smooth 30 frames per second output ensures lifelike motion and natural facial expressions.

💡 RightLight 2 Technology – Enjoy superior automatic light correction that adapts to different lighting conditions. Whether you’re in a dim room, bright sunlight, or backlit environment, your video will always remain sharp and well-balanced.

🎤 Noise-Reducing Microphone – The built-in mono microphone is designed to filter out background noise, delivering clear and crisp audio so your voice stands out during virtual meetings, online classes, or live streaming.

🤝 Certified Compatibility – This webcam is officially optimized for popular video conferencing platforms including Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, Skype, and more, making it ideal for both business and personal use.

⚙️ Logi Tune App Support – Take control of your video experience with the Logi Tune software, allowing you to customize brightness, contrast, color balance, and even enable firmware updates for the best performance.

🔒 Privacy & Eco-Friendly Design – Equipped with a convenient sliding shutter for complete privacy when not in use. Features USB-C connectivity for modern laptops and desktops, offers a 70° field of view, and is made using recycled plastic for sustainable, eco-conscious use.

name: HP 960 4K Streaming Webcam
details: 🎥 4K at 30fps or 1080p at 60fps – Enjoy stunning cinematic 4K clarity for presentations or ultra-smooth 60fps Full HD for streaming, gaming, and professional calls.
🎤 Dual Microphones – Built-in stereo microphones deliver natural voice capture while minimizing echo and background noise, ensuring crystal-clear conversations.
🌈 HDR + Advanced Color Correction – Automatic HDR adjustment enhances brightness, contrast, and colors, so your video always looks vibrant and true-to-life, even in tricky lighting.
🔦 Large 18mm F2.0 Lens – A premium wide-aperture lens captures sharp details and bright, noise-free video, making it ideal for low-light rooms or evening meetings.
🖼️ AI Auto Framing + Keystone Correction – Intelligent framing keeps you perfectly centered, while keystone correction eliminates distortion for a professional, studio-like look.
📐 Flexible Mounting Options – Features a 360° swivel, 90° tilt, 100° wide field of view, tripod compatibility, and a magnetic privacy cover for maximum versatility and security.

name: AIWaft 4K Webcam
details: 💻 Ultra-Clear 4K Quality – Experience stunningly sharp and smooth 4K Ultra HD video resolution that delivers lifelike clarity for streaming, gaming, online teaching, and professional video conferencing. Perfect for content creators and remote professionals who need cinematic detail and vibrant colors.

🎯 AI Auto-Focus – Advanced artificial intelligence technology ensures real-time focus adjustments, keeping your image sharp whether you’re moving, presenting, or sitting still. No more blurry frames—just professional-grade clarity at all times.

🎙 Dual Omnidirectional Microphones – Built-in high-sensitivity dual microphones capture your voice naturally and reduce ambient noise, ensuring crystal-clear audio for online meetings, live streaming, virtual classrooms, and video calls.

📐 Enhanced EPTZ – Equipped with advanced Electronic Pan, Tilt, and Zoom (EPTZ) functionality, this webcam allows flexible framing and seamless adjustments. Perfect for professional presentations, group calls, and creating engaging video content with ease.

🔊 2D Noise Reduction – Enjoy sharp, noise-free visuals with advanced 2D noise reduction technology. Optimized for low-light and high-contrast environments, it ensures brighter images, reduced grain, and clear detail even in challenging lighting conditions.

🗂 Multi-Platform Support – Works seamlessly with Windows, Linux, and Android systems, offering universal connectivity for laptops, desktops, and smart devices. Fully compatible with Zoom, Teams, Skype, Google Meet, and most major conferencing platforms.

📦 Compact & Durable – Designed with a lightweight 150g body and certified with ROHS, FCC, and CE standards for safety and reliability. The compact build ensures portability, while the durable construction guarantees long-lasting performance for both personal and professional use.

name: Kreo Owl Full HD Webcam
details: 🎯 Auto-Focus Precision – Stay perfectly sharp at all times with advanced continuous tracking and adjustment, ensuring your image remains clear even if you move around or shift positions during calls or recordings.

⚡ Full HD 1080p at 60fps – Enjoy smooth, lifelike video quality with high frame rates that eliminate lag and motion blur, making it ideal for professional meetings, live streaming, and high-quality content creation.
🔄 360° Rotation – Effortlessly swivel and adjust the webcam in any direction, allowing you to find the perfect angle whether you’re presenting, conferencing, or collaborating with a group.
🔒 Privacy Shutter – A built-in quick-slide cover gives you instant control over your camera, letting you block the lens completely when not in use for enhanced safety and peace of mind.
🎤 AI Noise Reduction Mic – The intelligent microphone technology reduces unwanted background noise, so your voice comes through crisp, clear, and professional in every conversation or recording.
🖥️ 78° Wide View – A balanced field of view that frames you naturally, making it perfect for solo presentations, online learning, or small group video calls without unnecessary distortion.
🔌 Plug & Play USB-A – Simple, driver-free setup that works right out of the box, offering broad compatibility with major operating systems and conferencing platforms for maximum convenience.

name: Lenovo 510 FHD Webcam
details: 🎥 1080p Full HD – Capture every detail with stunning clarity using a 1/2.9-inch RGB sensor that delivers professional-grade video for calls, conferences, and streaming.
🌐 Ultra-Wide 95° Lens – A wide-angle field of view ensures that more of your environment or participants are visible, while the 4x digital zoom lets you focus in on what matters most.
🎙 Dual Microphones – Equipped with high-sensitivity mics that pick up your voice clearly from up to 2 meters away, ensuring natural, echo-free conversations without the need for a headset.
🔒 Built-In Shutter – A convenient integrated privacy shutter gives you full control over when the camera is active, protecting your security and peace of mind with a quick slide.
👁️ Windows Hello 4.1 – Advanced facial recognition support allows fast, secure, and password-free login to your Windows device with just a glance.
📸 IR + RGB Lens – Combined infrared and RGB imaging technology works with the built-in IR LED to deliver excellent visibility and accuracy even in low-light conditions.
📍 Tripod Mount – Standard tripod mounting support gives you flexible placement options, so you can easily adjust angles for streaming, online classes, or professional meetings.
💻 OS Compatibility – Broad compatibility with both Windows and macOS ensures seamless integration across devices, making it suitable for home, office, or hybrid setups.
